Our story

About Chely Flowers

Chely Flowers is a small gift shop built around one idea: the best gifts are personal. We started with handmade sublimation gifts — photo mugs, tumblers and tote bags made one at a time for friends and family — and we're growing into a full gift shop.

On December 1, fresh flower arrangements join the shop, so you can pair a lasting personalized keepsake with fresh blooms in a single gift.

We proudly serve customers in English and Spanish. However you reach out, you'll be understood — and your gift will say exactly what you mean.

  • Handmade, made-to-order gifts
  • Bilingual service — English & Spanish
  • Flowers launching December 1

How do I send my photo?

Send the message first, then reply to our email with the original photo attached — the clearer the photo, the sharper the print.

Can I order in Spanish?

Yes! Write to us in Spanish or English — we serve customers in both languages.

When can I order flowers?

Flower arrangements launch December 1. Until then, all personalized gifts are available to order.
